hero.title: Run one community from a single cockpit.
hero.subtitle: Station masters see the whole picture, merchants run the store, neighborhood committees publish community content. People, shops, operations, and AI share one admin.
hero.note: Built for one community per station. Multi-community switching is on the roadmap.

roles.title: Three workspaces, one system
roles.subtitle: Each identity gets its own admin. The station master provisions accounts.

station.title: Station master
station.description: Dashboard, organizations, community services, residents, and AI ops.

merchant.title: Merchant / Property
merchant.description: Overview, orders, goods, campaigns, FAQs, and AI tools.

committee.title: Neighborhood committee
committee.description: Notices, events, news, columns, hotline, messages, and services.

feature1.title: See the community
feature1.description: Merchants, services, committees, and todos live on one dashboard.

feature2.title: Manage organizations
feature2.description: Onboard merchants, property, and committees. Proxy into their admin when needed.

feature3.title: Serve residents
feature3.description: Announcements, guides, steward, phone list, knowledge, and a feedback inbox.

feature4.title: Commerce and community
feature4.description: Stores sell and run campaigns. Committees publish. Two separate workspaces.

ai.title: AI as an operations assistant, not an unmanned community
ai.subtitle: Digital employees, a chat workbench, tools, and resident-facing skills are already in the admin.

item1.title: Digital employees
item1.description: OPC-style AI staff, grouped by department, for day-to-day ops.

item2.title: Chat workbench
item2.description: Station masters review resident conversations instead of typing as a call center.

item3.title: AI tools and sessions
item3.description: Station and merchant each get tools and conversation lists, scoped to the community.

item4.title: Resident AI tools
item4.description: Station masters configure categories and tools for residents on the consumer side.

scenarios.title: Who configures, who uses
scenarios.subtitle: Change it in the admin, and residents or merchants can consume it.

s1.title: Content reaches residents
s1.description: Station masters publish notices and convenience info. Residents see them on the community side.

s2.title: Merchants can sell
s2.description: Merchants list goods and campaigns. Orders come back to their workspace.

s3.title: Feedback closes the loop
s3.description: Resident feedback and AI chats are handled in the inbox and chat workbench.

access.title: Provisioned per community
access.subtitle: No public self-serve signup. One station cockpit per community. Downstream accounts are created by the station master.

open.title: Access
open.description: Provision a station-master account for the community.

roles.title: Included roles
roles.description: Station master, plus merchant, property, and committee accounts you can open.

next.title: Next step
next.description: Fill in the form below. Your implementation contact will reach out. Sign in if you already have an account.

applyForm.title: Request access
applyForm.subtitle: Leave your community and contact details. We will follow up to provision access.
applyForm.successHint: Someone will contact you on this number.

setup.title: Already provisioned? Open the cockpit.
setup.subtitle: Sign in with a station, merchant, property, or committee account.
